HEADLINE: The Board Meeting to be held on 13/11/2026 has been revised to 14/11/2026 This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated November 6, 2026, regarding the meeting of the Board of ....
MORE:
The Board Meeting to be held on 13/11/2026 has been revised to 14/11/2026 This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated November 6, 2026, regarding the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company scheduled to be held on Friday, November 13, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

In this regard, we wish to inform you that, due to a serious health issue concerning an immediate family member of the Managing Director, the Management could not be able to meet on a scheduled board meeting date i.e. on 13th November 2026. Consequently, the aforesaid Board Meeting has been postponed and rescheduled to Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Accordingly, the Board Meeting will now be held on Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 05:00 PM, inter alia, to consider and approve the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

The Board Meeting to be held on 13/11/2026 has been revised to 14/11/2026
